title: NÄSINGE table
description: NÄSINGE table, dark brown stained/beech veneer, 311/2x235/8" NÄSINGE dining series combines updated farmhouse charm with modern functionality. This 2-seat table with hardwood veneer top and hardwood chamfered legs adds coziness to smaller kitchens or living rooms.
features: Four plastic feet to protect the floor against scratches included.
A bit screwdriver is required to assemble this table, sold separately as a part of TRIXIG 15-piece toolset.
Matches well with NÄSINGE and BERGMUND chairs, sold separately.
materialAndCare: Table top: Particleboard, Clear acrylic lacquer, Fiberboard, Paper foil, Beech veneer, Stain, Clear lacquer; Under frame/ Leg: Solid wood, Adhesive, Stain, Clear acrylic lacquer
